text:
I got the invitation today! 😊🥳

I’m very happy to say that I’ve finally been invited to come to Israel after my partner submitted the final document.  I’m incredibly happy and excited, but now that it’s actually happening, I’m also starting to feel a little stressed! 😅 I generally know what I need to do next, but I’m worried there might be things I’m overlooking before I leave the Netherlands.

So I was wondering if anyone who has moved abroad (especially from the Netherlands to Israel) has any tips for preparing for such a big move?

I’d also love to know if there is a place where I can find information about which steps I need to take in the Netherlands before leaving, such as deregistering, insurance, taxes, banking, etc., to make sure everything is properly arranged for a smooth move. 
I’ve noticed that some rules and requirements can be different depending on your situation, especially when moving abroad to live with your partner, so I’m worried I might miss something important.

Any tips, experiences, or things you wish you had known before making this big move would be greatly appreciated! 🥰
